text:
ela: FYI support reported onboarding confusion: sample apps show different failure text for same 403. JS shows stack, Go prints 'auth failed', Python raises PermissionDeniedError. New devs can't tell whether to refresh creds or request scopes.

tom: We should standardize on intents + short user-facing line. Proposal: intents = authentication | authorization | rate_limit | conflict. SDKs expose AuthenticationError, PermissionDenied, RateLimitError, ConflictError (idiomatic names ok).

sara: User message pattern: one neutral sentence + one actionable hint. e.g. 'Permission denied: missing scope "inference.write". Grant scope or use a key with that role.' Tests should assert message contains a hint token (refresh/check scope/backoff).

tom: Also emit telemetry fields error_intent and error_code; keep raw upstream body in logs. Quickstart should not create keys that immediately cause 403 on write examples.

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-4001 "Friendly failure copy + SDK parity" assigned to @tom, @sara.
